scope: Post-hoc descriptive analysis of frozen maps and existing traces; no model, observer or reference changes and no new experiment.
limits: Criterion rankings concentrate on one Saga family and do not show universal criterion-policy suitability.
Hybrid versus local-progress differences are smaller than hybrid versus structure-only.
Interpretation of shared versus local learning remains confounded by exploration calibration and few seeds.
Historical maps retain different runtime provenance; matching structural vectors and inputs is not a controlled runtime experiment.
